extracted.name: Pop_p Fried Chicken (PFC)
extracted.description: Created this recipe thinking of eating something not eaten before. Had to be crunchy and crispy.
instruction_lines: Mix well all the marination ingredients and let it rest for about 1 hour or more
Add 1/2 cup water to all purpose flour and mix well
Dip the marinated chicken well in all purpose flour solution fix and then coat well with breadcrumbs
Deep fry/air fry. Hot crispy and crunchy PFC is ready!! Voila
